Can you get a sick leave certificate for bank employees online?

Bank employees in Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines and seven other South East Asian countries can request a sick leave certificate online from DrCertificate. After a chat consultation, an MBBS, MD or MS doctor decides whether to issue it, stating the dates you are unfit for work. The PDF arrives by email. Your bank decides whether to accept it.
Before you apply
What is a sick leave certificate for bank employees?

Banks rely on a note from a registered doctor, the sick leave certificate for bank employees, to confirm that you were ill and could not work on the listed dates. Bank HR teams use it to approve paid sick days and keep leave records accurate.

Banks run on tight staffing. Branch rosters, cash counter cover and compliance records depend on knowing who is absent and why, so HR often asks for medical proof once an absence runs past a day or two.
The certificate is not a diagnosis or a treatment.

DrCertificate is a platform that connects you with independent doctors, and the platform does not diagnose, treat or prescribe. If you need medicine or ongoing care, visit a clinic or your usual doctor.
When do bank employees need a sick leave certificate?
Bank employees usually need a sick leave certificate when illness keeps them off work longer than their bank allows without proof. Your bank's leave policy sets that trigger.

Banking roles bring their own pressure. A teller who calls in sick leaves a cash counter uncovered, and an operations officer who misses month end close or an audit visit will be asked to explain the gap.
Open your employee handbook before you apply.

Find how many days of absence trigger a certificate requirement and the deadline for handing it in. DrCertificate certificates are not for submission in India, but the rule shows how tight bank policies can be.

items: Absence of two days or more The most common trigger in bank leave policies.
Sick during month end or an audit HR wants absences in busy periods on record.
Sick on a remote work day Even home based shifts count as leave if you cannot work.

blocks.text: Which illnesses can a doctor consider for a bank employee sick leave certificate?
A doctor on DrCertificate may consider common short term illnesses that a chat consultation can assess. Each case is judged on its own, and the doctor can decline any request.
Long hours at a counter or desk, crowded branches and shift work all leave bank staff open to everyday bugs and strains. The examples are the kinds of complaint a doctor may review.

Emergencies are different. Chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting or a high fever that will not settle need in person care right away, so go to an emergency department or call your local emergency number.

items: Fever, cold and flu Short viral illness with fever, cough or sore throat.
Stomach upset and gastritis Vomiting, diarrhoea or acid pain lasting a day or two.
Migraine and tension headache Headaches that stop you working at a screen or counter.
Mild back or neck strain Pain from long periods of sitting or lifting cash boxes.

What does a sick leave certificate for bank employees cost?
A sick leave certificate for bank employees costs 25 SGD in Singapore, 399 pesos in the Philippines and 30 MYR in Malaysia. The price depends on your country.
The fee covers the doctor's review of your form, the chat consultation and, if approved, the certificate as a PDF by email. You pay through Stripe.
Payments are non refundable, including when the doctor declines. The one exception is a verified technical fault reported within 24 hours.
You'll continue on the secure DrCertificate application form.
What should bank employees check before applying?
Bank employees should confirm with HR that an online medical certificate is accepted before paying. Acceptance is always the receiving bank's decision.

Leave rules differ across the region. In the Philippines, the Omnibus Rules under the Labor Code give every covered employee with at least one year of service a yearly service incentive leave of five days with pay. Unused days convert to their money equivalent at the end of the year.
Your bank may grant more sick leave than this legal minimum, with its own proof rules, and each country in the region sets its own laws.
Have your ID, symptom start date, leave dates and email ready before you start.
The questions below are worth asking HR first.

items: 1 Step 1: Do you accept a PDF certificate from an online doctor? Get a yes before you pay.
2 Step 2: How many days of absence need a certificate? Check whether one sick day is enough to trigger it.
3 Step 3: What is the submission deadline? A few banks want it on your return day.
4 Step 4: Which details must appear on it? Compare the answer with the certificate fields above.

blocks.text: When is an online sick leave certificate not the right choice?

An online sick leave certificate is not right for emergencies. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing or sudden weakness, go to the nearest emergency department or call your local emergency number.
DrCertificate certificates must not be used for insurance claims or legal purposes, and they are not for submission in India. Applicants must be at least 16.
The service runs on chat consultation only.
DrCertificate offers no video or in person consultations, and the platform does not diagnose, treat or prescribe. For medicine, tests or follow up care, see a clinic near you.
Who reviews your sick leave certificate request?

Independent doctors with an MBBS, MD or MS degree review every request on DrCertificate, and each doctor is registered with a medical council. The doctor alone decides whether a sick leave certificate is issued and for which dates.
DrCertificate, run by Health Venture OU, handles the rest. The platform hosts the online form, takes payment through Stripe and emails the approved PDF.
Doctors decline about 2% of requests.
A decline usually happens when the name and ID do not match, or when the symptoms and details shared do not fit together. Accurate answers protect you and keep the certificate honest.
Questions about a request go to care@drcertificate.com. The office address is KMC Armstrong Corporate Center, H.V. Dela Costa, Salcedo Village, Makati City, 1227 Metro Manila, Philippines.
Frequently asked questions about sick leave certificates for bank employees
Will my bank accept an online sick leave certificate?

Your bank decides whether to accept an online sick leave certificate, and policies differ between banks. DrCertificate cannot promise acceptance. Before you apply, ask HR whether it accepts a PDF certificate from a registered doctor issued after a chat consultation, because the fee is non refundable.
How many sick leave days may a bank worker ask for online?

In most South East Asian countries, a sick leave note covers up to 7 days for generic symptoms. The doctor decides how many days to recommend after your consultation and may suggest a shorter period than you asked for. Longer or repeated absences are better handled at an in person visit.
Can the sick leave certificate be backdated?

Backdating is not guaranteed. The doctor sets the leave dates after reviewing your symptoms and timeline, and can decline dates that do not fit what you describe. Apply as soon as you fall ill and give honest dates, so the certificate matches what your bank's HR team expects.
What happens if the doctor declines my request?

If the doctor declines, no certificate is issued and the payment is not refunded. Doctors decline about 2% of requests, often because the name and ID do not match or the symptoms shared are inconsistent. Check every detail before submitting to avoid a decline.
I was sick on a remote work day. Which certificate do I need?

A sick leave certificate fits days when you were too unwell to work at all, even from home. If you can work but should not go into the branch or office, the Work From Home option on the DrCertificate form may suit you better. Ask HR which one it wants.
Can I correct a mistake on my certificate after it is issued?

A DrCertificate certificate cannot be corrected once issued, unless the error came from the medical team. Typing errors in your own name, ID or dates stay on the PDF. Read every field on the form before paying, and make sure your name matches your ID.
